The main takeaway from our work is that

the optimal power allocation scheme for the downlink two-user IC is not a simple extension of that for the downlink single-user channel, and that the optimal power distribution between users depends on the degree of interference.
a simple power allocation scheme can achieve a high throughput in the downlink two-user channel.

the optimal transmit power is divided to two users, as opposed to being allocated to one user in the greedy scheme or to be divided equally in the water-filing scheme, when the channel states are close to each other and the degree of interference is not so high.
